violations.description: Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Walls, and ceiling in the dry storage room were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. An open drink container was stored on the prep counter in the kitchen.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. Hot dogs in an ice bath maintained an internal temperature of 48 F
Method, clean, temp, concentration, exposure time, equipment/utensils sanitized (4 pts deducted)
Hot holding and cold holding temperatures maintained, unwrapped food not reserved (5 pts deducted)
